answer: A bonded staking registry mitigates Sybil attacks by forcing agents to lock scarce financial collateral into an escrow contract before transacting. Facing a sudden gale of forged personas, an adversary enters an unsustainable cost spiral because each identity requires dedicated, slashable capital. However, this defense fractures like brittle shale during token volatility: market dips make mass registration cheap, while price spikes exclude legitimate, low-budget agents.
